## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle Tang Cintāmaṇi-cakra dhāraṇī-sūtra translated by the Khotanese master **Śikṣānanda** ([實叉難陀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AF%A6%E5%8F%89%E9%9B%A3%E9%99%80), 652–710), best known as the lead translator of the eighty-fascicle *Avataṃsaka-sūtra* (T279) under [武則天](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%AD%A6%E5%89%87%E5%A4%A9) Wǔ Zétiān's sponsorship. The colophon names him 唐于闐三藏 — "Khotanese Tripiṭaka master of the Tang." The text is one of the four Tang Cintāmaṇi-cakra recensions ([KR6j0287](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0287), [KR6j0288](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0288), [KR6j0289](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0289), [KR6j0290](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0290)).

**Abstract**

The opening situates the discourse at *Kheṭa-ṣaila* (伽栗斯山, the same Avalokiteśvara mountain as in [KR6j0287](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0287) and [KR6j0288](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0288)). The first chapter is *Chúpò yīqiè èyè tuóluóní pǐn dìyī* 除破一切惡業陀羅尼品第一 — the dhāraṇī chapter on destroying all evil karma. Śikṣānanda's recension is somewhat more elaborately structured than Yìjìng's parallel ([KR6j0288](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0288)), with multiple *pǐn* and a richer ritual elaboration. The "secret treasury" (祕密藏) framing places the text within the Esoteric *kalpa* genre proper. The work was translated during Śikṣānanda's principal period of imperial sponsorship under Wǔ Zétiān, between his arrival in 695 and the Shénlóng 神龍 *jiǔshì* 久視 era (cf. [仁岳](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%BB%81%E5%B2%B3) Rényuè's note in [KR6j0295](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0295): "一實叉難陀此云覺喜唐天后久視元年譯八紙"). CANWWW (T20N1082) cross-references the parallel recensions.
